name: files.write
description: Create, append to, or overwrite a text/code file inside an allowed workspace root after explicit approval. Use for natural edit requests such as putting text in README.md, appending text to README.md, creating test.md with content, or modifying source code.

args_schema.path: absolute path inside allowed roots or path relative to current workspace
args_schema.content: full text content to write into the file
args_schema.content_from_previous_step: true only inside a multi_tool_plan when files.write should write the prior tool's returned text/markdown
args_schema.overwrite: true only when replacing an existing file after explicit approval
args_schema.append: true when adding content to the end of an existing file instead of replacing it
args_schema.append_newline: true to insert a newline before appended content when the file does not already end with one
